source_notes_chirho.text_chirho: Marks a place where we agree with BHQ against BHS in reading L.
We read one or more accents in L differently than BHS. Often this notation indicates a typographical error in BHS.

sources_chirho.title_chirho: Obadiah: Global Bible Tools approved English gloss export
sources_chirho.license_chirho: CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), dedicated by Global Bible Tools itself. In globalbibletools/platform@5d4041d4, src/ui/study/components/AttributionDialog.tsx gives the glosses of every language except English New Testament the use {type: "self", licenseCode: "cc0_1_0"}, which src/messages/en.json renders as "English Glosses by Global Bible Tools are available under Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal". Only English New Testament glosses (Alan Bunning, CNTR) are "used with permission"; this is an Old Testament file, GBT's own export at the recorded commit. GBT's exporter has since skipped English, citing only the New Testament glosses' licence. The globalbibletools/data repository carries no LICENSE file; the dedication is GBT's published statement in its platform. Checked 2026-10-27 (spec-chirho/research-chirho/26-10-27-release-license-check-chirho.md).
sources_chirho.attribution_chirho: English Glosses by Global Bible Tools (https://globalbibletools.com) are available under Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
